title: Microsoft Copilot: realtime voice conversations in Word and PowerPoint
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts match the record, and its Microsoft Copilot background is supported without being presented as confirmed behaviour for voice in Word and PowerPoint. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps. One checklist item refers to reporting and audit processes that have no controls-table row.
